apply_persistent_class_decorator: apply the persistent_class decorator to a PyTorch module class to save its source code when pickled
check_is_persistent: check whether a given object or class is persistent and will save source code when pickled
register_import_hook: register an import hook function that modifies metadata when a persistent object is being unpickled
query_init_args_kwargs: query the init_args and init_kwargs properties of a persistent class instance to reconstruct it
check_pickleable: check that a given object is pickleable by recursively validating its contents without full serialization
